leagues.name: Texas High School Lacrosse League
leagues.notes: 4 competitive classes (A / B / C / D) + JV + Sixes; 4 geographic districts (North / Central / San Antonio / South); 89 member school programs; 3,289+ athletes

leagues.name: Texas Girls High School Lacrosse League
leagues.region: Texas statewide (+ S. Oklahoma / NW Louisiana)
leagues.notes: DI / DII / DIII competitive divisions; 3 districts: North (DFW) / Central (Austin-SA) / South (Houston)

leagues.name: DFW Youth Lacrosse League
leagues.notes: ~30 member club programs (Allen / Coppell / Denton / Frisco / Fort Worth etc.); founded 2013; girls equivalent is TGYLL

leagues.name: Texas Girls Youth Lacrosse League
leagues.notes: Premier girls youth league for DFW area; member programs include Prosper / Rockwall / Southlake Carroll and several private schools

leagues.name: Central Texas Youth Lacrosse Association
leagues.notes: Governs community and school-based programs in Austin metro; annual playoff championship weekend; school-affiliated club model

leagues.name: South Texas Youth Lacrosse Association
leagues.notes: Publishes in-season standings and game schedules; San Antonio–based regional league

leagues.name: Houston Youth Area Lacrosse League
leagues.notes: First USA Lacrosse-sanctioned league in Houston; 13 affiliated member clubs; end-of-year all-star game and tournament

leagues.name: Greater Houston Youth Lacrosse Association
leagues.notes: ~1,300 boys on 82 teams across 4 grade levels; formed 2011; separate from HYALL; sister org is GHGYLA for girls

leagues.name: Greater Houston Girls Youth Lacrosse Association
leagues.notes: Sister organization to GHYLA (boys); hosts end-of-season tournament in May; separate governance from boys program

leagues.name: Houston Youth Lacrosse — Spring League
leagues.notes: Club-organized seasonal league with boys and girls divisions; Lady Hornets girls program; also runs summer and fall seasons
